questions.Description:
Write and Execute MATLAB/Scilab/Octave program to plot the following continuous time signals
--   step function
--   impulse function
--   exponential function
--   ramp function
--   sine function
--   random signal

Write and Execute a MATLAB/Scilab/Octave program to plot the following discrete time signals
--   step function
--   impulse function
--   exponential function
--   ramp function
--   sine function
--   random signal
Write and Execute a MATLAB/Scilab/Octave code to perform time scaling and time shifting of a given signal.
Write and Execute a MATLAB/Scilab/Octave code to calculate and plot Fourier Transform of a given signal.
Write and Execute a MATLAB/Scilab/Octave code to verify Parseval’s theorem.
Write and Execute a MATLAB/SciLab/Octave code to laplace transform and inverse laplace transform.
Write and Execute a MATLAB/SciLab/Octave code to the pole-zero plot for the given signal.
Write and Execute a MATLAB/Scilab/Octave code to calculate and plot Z- Transform of a given signal.
Write MATLAB/Scilab/Octave Program to find inverse Z-transform for the given sequence.
Write and Execute MATLAB/Scilab/Octave code to find the response of LTI system to any random input.
